title: Companion terminal chooser exact target and draft
description: Uses an already-running private gateway Copilot. NATIVE_COMPANION_TERMINAL_STATE records its exact worker ref and a draft sentinel. The draft is never sent.

open.intent: Open the Co-Pilot chooser with a pending instruction.

choose.intent: Choose the existing gateway-owned terminal from Companion.

wait-terminal.intent: The existing terminal client opens for the shared Co-Pilot.

wait-draft.intent: The draft remains editable rather than being sent automatically.

verify.intent: Compare the actual mobile route to the exact gateway worker ref and unchanged delivery receipt.

capture.intent: Record the terminal identity and preserved unsent draft.
